result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and parallel parking. While the narrow street width naturally encourages lower speeds, the environment lacks marked crossings and features significant visual obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the narrow street significantly limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Speed Humps

result.summary: The image depicts a dense urban streetscape with row houses and a ground-floor commercial space. A continuous paved sidewalk is present, buffered from the travel lane by on-street parallel parking, though it is partially narrowed by potted plants and street furniture.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow, one-way urban street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and a mature tree canopy. The environment is relatively calm with low-speed geometry, though sightlines are partially obstructed by parked cars and the effective sidewalk width is constrained by tree pits.

hazards.description: Parked cars and mature trees along the curb line significantly block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lane.

interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.description: Install a raised crosswalk at the intersection to slow vehicle speeds and improve pedestrian visibility and priority.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Expansion
interventions.description: Repair uneven sidewalk sections and consider widening the walkway where tree pits currently restrict the clear path.
